note: NVIDIA Earth-2 model output as an ArWen source, as TABLE DATA. Earth2Studio (NVIDIA, Apache-2.0, pip earth2studio) is the common runtime for these models, and its NetCDF4Backend writes every model's output in ONE vocabulary: one variable per field and pressure level (t850, z500, q700, u10m, msl ...), dimensions (time, lead_time, lat, lon), the initialization as 'time' and the forecast offset as 'lead_time', on the 0.25-degree 721x1440 global grid with latitude north-to-south. Its lexicon fixes the units, so the files carry none; the packaged mapping supplies them through producer_attributes. A model reaches ArWen by being a row here whose 'profile' names a packaged profile whose mapping its vocabulary satisfies. Adding a model is a row: no adapter code. 'gpuwm fetch --source earth2 --model M' reads this table to run the model through earth2studio and write the file the row reads.

fcn3.proven: 2026-10-19: FCN3 96 h from ERA5 2015-09-27 00Z, ArWen 1200x500 km at 2.5 km for 48 h from its +48 h state (Earth-2 campaign report, 2026-10-19)

memory.basis: Conservative allowance for sequential per-member forward in Earth2Studio 0.19.0; capacity estimate, not a measured batch peak. Validate actual peak in runner receipt.

fcn3.vram_note: FCN3 inference needs 17 GiB of free GPU memory (a 24 GB card or larger) on the pinned stack (earth2studio 0.19.0, torch-harmonics 0.8.1 a632ca7, torch 2.14.1 cu13). Measured on an RTX PRO 6000 96 GB, 2026-10-21, gpuwm fetch --source earth2-fcn3 --cycle 2024-10-08T00 --hours 24, one member, batch_size 1, under a 30,000 MiB card lease: card memory peak 16,552 MiB (process-tree nvidia-smi sampler), torch max_memory_allocated 13.969 GiB, max_memory_reserved 15.512 GiB (earth2-run.json). 17 GiB is that measured peak rounded up. The earlier 59 GiB floor (60,212 MiB card peak, 49.3 GiB allocated) measured the runner's DISCO band patch not applying to torch-harmonics 0.8.1, so its whole expanded convolution input and the einsum's permuted copy were resident at once; gpuwm/earth2_runner.py now contracts that layout one channel slice and latitude band at a time.

ai_cost.basis: Measured model load plus synchronized inference for one member, 6 forecast hours; flat per-model display estimate, not scaled by requested horizon. Excludes initial-data fetch and output tail.
